name: @cross-code/nx-buck2
description: Nx plugin for Buck2 — cross-compilation native builds with debug/release profiles, size optimization, and symbol preservation.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && for d in executors/build executors/test executors/run generators/init generators/project; do cp src/$d/schema.json $d/schema.json 2>/dev/null; done
